overview.title: The $15,000 meme-page ad campaign that brought no sales
overview.summary: A host asks Greg Lav about a risk that did not work out. He explains that early marketing for Bloom pushed people to follow Mari Llewellyn's Instagram, then describes putting $15,000 into a meme-page ad campaign in one day. The followers that arrived had Indian names, the comments were in other languages, and there was no Shopify traffic.

chapters.title: The question
chapters.summary: A host asks when a risk did not work out.

chapters.title: Community-first marketing
chapters.summary: Early marketing told people to follow Mari Llewellyn's Instagram instead of buying Bloom, to build a community for the long game.

chapters.title: All in on meme pages
chapters.summary: He bought ads on meme pages and one day put $15,000 into a single meme-page campaign over 24 hours.

chapters.title: What came back
chapters.summary: The new followers had Indian names, the comments were in different languages, and there was no Shopify traffic.
